title: Inductive step of the circuit-to-decision-tree reduction
statement:
Let $f:\{0,1\}^n \to \{0,1\}$ be a Boolean function on $n \ge 1$ variables, and fix natural numbers $d,s,w,l,t$ with $d \ge 3$ and $s,w,l \ge 1$. Suppose $f$ is computed by a Boolean circuit of depth at most $d$, size at most $s$, and maximum fan-in at most $w$. For parameters $w,l$ and a depth $e$, write $\delta_e = \frac{1}{40w}\left(\frac{1}{40l}\right)^{e-2}$ for the composed restriction parameter; let $D(g)$ denote the decision-tree depth of a Boolean function $g$, and let $g|_\rho$ denote its restriction by a restriction $\rho$. Assume the following inductive hypothesis: for every Boolean function $g$ on $n$ variables and every integer $s' \ge 1$, if $g$ is computed by a circuit of depth at most $d-1$, size at most $s'$, and maximum fan-in at most $w$, then under a Bernoulli random restriction $\rho$ with parameter $\delta_{d-1}$,
\[
  \Pr_{\rho}\!\left[D(g|_\rho) > l\right] \le (s'-1)(1/2)^{l} + (1/2)^{l} + (s'-1)\exp\!\left(-\tfrac{n}{120w}\right) + s'\exp\!\left(-\tfrac{n}{120l}\right).
\]
Then under a Bernoulli random restriction $\rho$ with parameter $\delta_{d}$,
\[
  \Pr_{\rho}\!\left[D(f|_\rho) > t\right] \le (s-1)(1/2)^{l} + (1/2)^{t} + (s-1)\exp\!\left(-\tfrac{n}{120w}\right) + s\exp\!\left(-\tfrac{n}{120l}\right).
\]
hypotheses_covered: f is a Boolean function on n variables
d, s, w, l, t are natural numbers
f is computed by a circuit of depth <= d, size <= s, max fan-in <= w
inductive hypothesis: the depth-(d-1) bound holds for every function computed by a circuit of depth <= d-1, size <= s', fan-in <= w, for all s' > 0
replaced:
The inductive step: for depth $d\ge 3$, assuming the bound holds for depth $d-1$ (the
hypothesis $\mathit{ih}$ applied to each child of the root), a circuit of depth at most $d$,
size at most $s$, and fan-in at most $w$ satisfies, under $\mathrm{composedDelta}(w,l,d)$,
\[
  \Pr\!\left[\mathrm{dtDepth}(\mathrm{restrictFn}\,f\,\rho) > t\right]
  \le (s-1)(1/2)^{l} + (1/2)^{t} + (s-1)\exp\!\left(-\tfrac{n}{120w}\right)
    + s\,\exp\!\left(-\tfrac{n}{120l}\right).
\]
